# HttpProtectOptions.redisOptions property

ioredis connection options, used only when [HttpProtectOptions.redis](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.httpprotectoptions.redis/) is not given.

**Signature:**

```typescript
redisOptions?: RedisOptions;
```

## Remarks

Omitting both means the constructor connects to `localhost:6379`<!-- -->. There is no lazy mode: the connection is opened by the constructor, so a [HttpProtect](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.httpprotect/) built in a process with no Redis reachable will emit ioredis connection errors on its own client rather than failing to construct.
